name: APEX Hit Sounds And Kill Icon
teaser:
I'm fascinated by the Apex Legends hit sound effects，so i maked it.

There are  many sound effects included.

Light Ammo Hit​,Disruptor Rounds Armor Hit, Light Ammo KillHit,Heavy Ammo KillHit etc.
description_html:
First of all,you need to downloadAmands’s Hitmarker - SPT Mods Workshop (sp-tarkov.com)

The newest version can be downloaded on GitHub：GitHub - Amands2Mello/AmandsHitmarker

How to use it?

1.Download and unzip to BepInEx

2.start your game

3.Press F12 and find setting HitmarkerSound/KillHitmarkersound then change the last number like Armor.wav to Armor1.wav，and find your favourite sounds.

4.Enjoy it

Armor：Original Hit;

Armor1：Disruptor Rounds Armor Hit;

ArmorBreak：Flat Armorbreak

ArmorBreak1：Ascending Armorbreak

Killhitmarker：Light Ammo shotdown

Killhitmarker1：Heavy Ammo shotdown

Killhitmarker2：Shotgun Ammo shotdown

Killhitmarker3：Arrow shotdown

Caution！！！！！

It will cover Amanda Hitmarker sound effect and kill Icon！You need to backup original files

Kill Icon

rank 5 &10 : Bronze

rank 15 & 20 : Silver

rank 25 & 30 : Gold

rank 35 & 40 : Platinum

rank 45 & 50 : Diamond

rank 55 & 60 : Master

rank more than 65 Predator

Other

ArmorBreak Icon was changed too

You must press F12 and find setting ArmorBreakShape,and change the last number like ArmorBreak.png to ArmorBreak1.png .
